<a id="selection-through-the-couplings--经耦合的选择"></a>
# Selection through the couplings

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-through-couplings` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](selection-through-couplings.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the coupling closure; pooled couplings select an ending beyond it within reach, and a flow raising what couples in from beyond is selected.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A selection is any claim about level histories; it goes through a formation's couplings up to a step when any two histories alike through those couplings up to that step are both selected or both not, and a score goes through them when they score alike. Being alike through the couplings is transitive, so an equivalence. (`Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough`, `Becoming.Web.ScoresThrough`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThrough.trans`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo.trans`)
2. With no premise, two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through those couplings up to the step; the class alike through them is itself such a selection, so where they are apart through them some selection through the couplings holds at one and fails at the other. (`Becoming.Web.selects_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Web.class_selects`, `Becoming.Web.separates`)
3. A selection through the couplings is excluded by its selector exactly where it fails; admission at a step up to the given one is a selection through the couplings, the level of a condition coupled in by level at such a step a score through them, and a score's threshold a selection through them; going through the couplings survives later steps, more coupling by level, negation and conjunction. (`Becoming.Web.Excludes`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.excludes_iff`, `Becoming.Web.admits_through`, `Becoming.Web.observed_scores`, `Becoming.Web.ScoresThrough.atLeast`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.later`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.widen`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.not`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.and`)
4. Where being alike through the couplings with the first history is decidable, two histories are scored alike by every score through the couplings exactly when they are alike through them. (`Becoming.Web.scores_alike_iff`)
5. For a group, a selection goes through its pooled couplings when histories alike through every member's couplings are selected alike; the same equivalence and separation hold; a member's selection is a group selection, and group selections are closed under conjunction. (`Becoming.Web.SelectsThroughAll`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughAll`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughAll.refl`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughAll.symm`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughAll.trans`, `Becoming.Web.selects_alike_all_iff`, `Becoming.Web.separates_all`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough.all`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThroughAll.and`)
6. Blindness beyond the coupling closure: with a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what couples into members of a formation's coupling closure, and every member of the part beyond that closure, every selection and score through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike, as does every group whose members lie within it. (`Becoming.Flow.WithinCoupling`, `Becoming.Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.unscored_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_all`)
7. Where two flows both balance at each step on the conditions coupled in within the coupling closure drawn through both, have the same formations present, start alike on what couples in, and members respond only through their own couplings, every selection through the couplings of a formation within that closure selects the two flows' levels alike. (`Becoming.Flow.CoupledFromEither`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_within_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_responsive`)
8. Share among descendants, an application of share_rises: where a selection holds for the history of every parent in one non-empty list and for none in another, the parents it holds for have at least a offspring and the others at most b, and b < a, the offspring of the first list stand to those of the second strictly more than the first list stands to the second. (`Becoming.share_rises_through`, `Becoming.share_rises`, `Becoming.offspringCount`)
9. In Clearing every selection through the clearer's couplings (support only) selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second, and that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's couplings at no step; the dweller lies within the clearer's reach closure and beyond its coupling closure, and the habitat does not couple into the clearer. (`Becoming.Clearing.unselected`, `Becoming.Clearing.dweller_within_reach`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinReach`)
10. In Clearing the dweller's admission at the third step goes through the dweller's couplings and separates the two worlds; both being admitted at the third step goes through the pooled couplings of the two, separates the worlds, and goes through neither's couplings alone. (`Becoming.Clearing.selected_by_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.BothAdmitted`, `Becoming.Clearing.selected_pooled`)
11. In Diversion the diverting flow takes a unit from the source a dweller depends on and gives it to the store coupled into the taker by level, reaching the dweller beyond the coupling closure; that the store stands at least one at the second step goes through the taker's couplings, holds in the diverting flow and fails in the undiverted one. (`Becoming.Diversion.diverting`, `Becoming.Diversion.undiverted`, `Becoming.Diversion.StoreAtLeast`, `Becoming.Diversion.favours`)
12. The dweller is unsupported from the second step on in the diverting flow and supported at every step in the undiverted one; every selection through the taker's couplings selects the diverting flow alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond. (`Becoming.Diversion.favours`, `Becoming.Diversion.supplying`, `Becoming.Diversion.blind_to_source`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- That a selection goes through the couplings (Web.SelectsThrough, Web.ScoresThrough, Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a supplied condition written into each theorem that uses it, never derived; a selection is any claim about level histories.
- Blindness beyond the coupling closure further assumes the conditions of Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling: the rest of the exchange fixed (a part withheld, WithheldLevels); balance assumed only on the conditions coupled into members of the coupling closure, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); every member of the part beyond the coupling closure.
- The responsive form assumes the hypotheses of Flow.alike_within_coupling: both flows balanced at each step on the conditions coupled in, the same formations present in both flows, the same start on what couples in, members responding only through their own couplings.
- The converse of the law for scores takes the decidability of being alike through the couplings with the first history as a named hypothesis (decided); the law for selections needs no decision.
- share_rises_through: the parents' histories, the lower and upper bounds on offspring (rewarded, unrewarded), b < a and both kinds of parent present are supplied; transmission is not part of it.
- For the witnesses: Clearing's flows and webs (from the modules of feeding closure, feedback and testing), and Diversion's three flows and webs.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The laws do not derive who selects, what couples into the selector, whether an actual selection goes through the couplings, whether offspring follow the selection, or whether reaching beyond is chosen.
- The more couples in, the larger the coupling closure and the smaller the gap: the law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector.
- The main law is near-definitional and the blindness a one-line corollary of the theorems of testing-within-registration; the contribution is conceptual.
- share_rises_through is an application, and its combination with transmission and an open world is a reading; where others respond to the stock a selection rests on, the response hypotheses can fail.
- The formation of arbitrary physical primitives and more general rule-changing capture keep their own scope.
- Known as the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975, Amodei and others 2016, Manheim and Garrabrant 2018); Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell (NeurIPS 2020) prove a stronger, quantitative form.
- **Counterexample:** Selection is blind to the gap: in Clearing every selection through the clearer's couplings selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second; that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's couplings at no step (Clearing.unselected). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Only pooled couplings select it: that both the dweller and the clearer are admitted at the third step goes through their pooled couplings and separates the cleared from the spared world, yet goes through neither's couplings alone (Clearing.selected_pooled). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Selection cannot tell reaching beyond from not: in Diversion every selection through the taker's couplings selects the flow diverting from the dweller's source alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond, while the dweller is unsupported only in the first (Diversion.blind_to_source); the same selection selects the diverting flow over the undiverted one (Diversion.favours). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

On 12 October 2026 Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?” and pasted an explanation of causal systems of unstated authorship (neither Ren's wording nor a premise); after the AI's comparison and its five proposals, Ren wrote “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This record is the first of them. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): any selection decided by what couples into a selector (keeping, rewarding, reproducing, training) reaches exactly what couples into it, blind to whatever a candidate's part does beyond the selector's coupling closure, however far its reach closure extends; the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, closing only through dependence, coupling by level or another's couplings pooled; where reaching beyond raises what couples in, selection favours it, and with share_rises the share of what reaches beyond rises while the world is open; for AI training, a reward process is a selector and training reaches only what couples into the reward. The AI, on its own account, connects this with the title of Ren's paper “When Capability Outruns Correction”. See §86 of the integration note.

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [testing-within-couplings](testing-within-couplings.md). Reuses Web.AlikeThrough, Web.AlikeThroughUpTo (refl, symm, earlier, of_obs), Web.ClassThrough, Web.Excludes (not_meets), Web.AlikeThroughAll, Flow.WithinCoupling, Flow.withinCoupling_thresholdOnly, Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling, Flow.alike_within_coupling, and the witness's Clearing.alike_for_clearer, tested_by_dweller, DwellerEnded, resourceGone and clearerAndDweller. The delta carries being alike through the couplings over to selection: selection through the couplings reaches exactly what couples in, and blindness beyond the coupling closure holds of every such selection.
  - Output: What is alike through the couplings; the coupling closure; nothing beyond it shows within it; the clearer's and the dweller's testing.
  - Input: What a selection through the couplings can tell apart; its blindness beyond the coupling closure; the witnesses of the gap.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance only on the conditions coupled in, at each step; the rest of the exchange fixed, or members responding only through their own couplings. [Testing.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [levels-of-closure](levels-of-closure.md). Reuses the closure under a relation (WithinClosure, ClosedUnder), the reach closure (Flow.WithinReach) and, in Clearing, the reach closure lying between the clearer and the whole (Clearing.reach_middle). The gap is a candidate's reach closure less the selector's coupling closure.
  - Output: The reach closure; the dweller within the clearer's reach closure.
  - Input: One side of the gap: where a candidate's part reaches.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Feedback.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Feedback.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [feedback-and-reach](feedback-and-reach.md). Reuses the clearer's witness (Clearing.resource_of_clearer). There a formation's feedback carries at most its influence closure while its part reaches into its reach closure; here selection through the couplings also stops at the coupling closure, and the gap is the difference.
  - Output: The clearer's part reaches the resource the dweller depends on.
  - Input: The witness of the gap in Clearing.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Feedback.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Feedback.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [target-capture](target-capture.md). Reuses share_rises and offspringCount. share_rises_through is an application of share_rises: the selection supplies which parents are carriers, and no arithmetic is added.
  - Output: Where each carrier leaves more offspring, the carriers' share rises among the offspring.
  - Input: The share of the parents a selection holds for rises.
  - Preserved conditions: The bounds on offspring and b < a are supplied; both kinds of parent present. [Capture.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Capture.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [runaway-distance-uncoupled](runaway-distance-uncoupled.md). There a policy through the couplings cannot use a stock coupled into it by threshold only; here a selection through the couplings cannot select on a part that does not couple into the selector.
- related, not a proved adapter: [evolution-on-descent](evolution-on-descent.md). There the counting form of Price's equation leaves the selection term unstated; P62 gives the rise of a share, and here a selection through the couplings supplies the carriers (an application).
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-under-registration-revision](selection-under-registration-revision.md). P93 completes choice preservation/loss when the lumping changes, and local executed reconstruction; acquired recipes and general capture remain open.
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-through-a-model-of-the-options](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.md). A law of the same form: selection through the couplings reaches exactly what couples in, and selection through a map separates exactly what the map separates; where the map ties two alternatives, every selection through it selects them alike.
- related, not a proved adapter: [the-gap-for-ones-own-act](the-gap-for-ones-own-act.md). There the gap for one's own act is a general theorem: the response premise of Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_responsive derived from a law of exchange, for any act whose difference stays beyond the closure.
- related, not a proved adapter: [raising-what-couples-in-draws-from-beyond](raising-what-couples-in-draws-from-beyond.md). There favouring reaching beyond is a general law: where a family containing what couples in gains nothing, a rise of what couples in is drawn from beyond it, so a selection rewarding the rise rewards the draw; Diversion is its instance.
